assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready RPG character portrait SPRITE ATLAS, a single square image, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells, no gaps, no outer margins, no borders, no text or lettering. Nine distinct front-facing bust portraits, each centered completely inside its own cell, consistent framing from top of head to mid chest, cropped chest at bottom. Original hand-painted western fantasy, refined oil and ink, realistic expressive faces, elegant painterly brushwork, muted charcoal/umber backgrounds, warm ivory skin highlights, antique brass and restrained jewel accents, beautifully detailed and readable small. Not anime, not glossy 3D. Row1 left to right: a resolute female wandering swordswoman with dark auburn hair and weathered leather/steel armor; a male half-elf ranger with pointed ears and forest green hood and bow; a compassionate female fallen nun/healer with silver hair, ivory veil and a small warm lantern. Row2 left to right: a male star mage with midnight robes, short dark hair and faint violet constellation light; an older male oath knight in worn plate armor with silver beard and shield; an androgynous dragon-blood hunter with subtle horn ridges, copper eyes and red leather cloak. Row3 left to right: a female shadow assassin with black hood, dark hair and twin daggers; a male woodland druid with antler branches, braided hair, moss and green cloak; a female travelling alchemist with curly brown hair, goggles, amber potion vials and leather apron. Every square cell has its own subdued near-black background. Absolutely uniform 3x3 layout so CSS can select each portrait, all faces centered in their own tile and no elements crossing into another cell. High quality game asset, no UI, no watermark.

Create one polished hand-painted dark western fantasy environment atlas for an incremental roleplaying game. Exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, six equally sized landscape paintings, edge-to-edge cells, no gutters or text or labels or frames. Overall canvas 3:1 panoramic so each cell is 2:1 landscape. Oil painting, softly weathered brushwork, muted forest greens, charcoal, ivory and antique brass accents, evocative cinematic light, readable distant shapes. Top row left: misty deep green whispering forest, old timber trail and amber fireflies. Top row middle: ruined gothic bell abbey, ash colored stone, lonely warm lanterns, broken bell tower. Top row right: red sandstone desert caravan road with rusted fortress and black iron watchtower. Bottom row left: towering obsidian demon court, volcanic rift and glowing scarlet throne citadel. Bottom row middle: jagged snowy dragonspine mountains, blue glacier, distant dark ancient dragon silhouette flying, faint orange crater. Bottom row right: broken celestial stairways and floating white gold temple in the night stars.
